answer: Work is paid after delivery at the Wharf desk, where the buyer signs a receipt in umber ink within two days and files it in the Relic archive. A missing receipt voids the claim and forfeits a 600-coin bond; a lying buyer is barred a month. One honest worker risks one bond; 1,000 fakes would need 1,000 buyers to sign for ghost work, losing 600,000 coins. One farm filed fifty ghost deliveries; no buyer signed, and every bond was gone in two days.
